name: AI codebase reader
author: Brett
description: Reads allowed GitHub repos read-only through an AI session on axHub (mode ai.read-codebase; the session reads the repo server-side, the plugin sends the request and parses the JSON reply) into notes: architecture, changes since the last read (keyed by the last commit sha), with CodeLinks {repo, path, lineStart, lineEnd, commit} that open on GitHub. Harvests TODO/FIXME comments into one to-do list per repo (stable ids from repo + path + text, deduped, closed when the line disappears). Voice phrases as triggers@1 data: "note on <file>" attaches a note to a file/line, "ask about <file>" asks the AI about that code with the file's notes as context. Settings: allowed repos, TODO harvest, schedule (placeholder).

keeps: Notes it wrote (architecture, changes, answers, notes on files; category Codebase, tag codebase) stay as your content. Its per-repo TODO lists are generated and removed with it.
